# 06 - Calculation step on PostgreSQL with commit and restart boundaries

<!-- Generated by modernization/design/tools/build_design.py - edit design_data.py or tickets_data.py and run `make design`. -->

- **Work item:** INT-T06 - calcInterestStep reads the replica tables, writes interest_transaction and updates account, one account per item, and a failed run can be restarted without charging twice.
- **Source:** `Cognition-Partner-Workshops/ts-cobol-carddemo`, baseline `6face58c092d254a9b89ce8bbfbddce561720a40`, stream root INTCALC (`app/jcl/INTCALC.jcl` -> `app/cbl/CBACT04C.cbl`). Branch from `demo/04-design` or its successor.
- **Context:**
  - Rules: INT-R01, INT-R07, INT-Q04, INT-H02, INT-T02 (`modernization/rules/interest/rules.yaml`)
  - Architecture: `modernization/design/architecture.md` version 0.1.0. Sections Job boundary, Transaction boundaries and Restart boundaries. The JDBC adapters implement the ports of FI-3; the domain code of ticket 04 is not changed.
  - Data-map rows (`modernization/design/data-map-interest.md`): CVTRA01Y all rows (read order, rule E6; the record echoed to SYSOUT, INT-T02); CVACT01Y rows marked written; CVTRA05Y all rows; extra columns of interest_transaction
  - Decisions: REL-11 is open and implemented as proposed (restart from the last committed account). INT-H02 is open: rerunGuard stays OFF, so a new run is not refused
- **Scope:**
  - Allowed files:
    - java/interest/src/main/java/**/jdbc/**
    - java/interest/src/main/java/**/batch/**
    - java/interest/src/test/**
  - Frozen shared interfaces:
    - FI-1 Record layouts (app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy, CVACT03Y.cpy, CVTRA01Y.cpy, CVTRA02Y.cpy, CVTRA05Y.cpy)
    - FI-3 Ports of the calculation (java/interest: package com.carddemo.interest.port (BalanceSource, AccountStore, CardLookup, RateLookup, TransactionSink, RunLog))
    - FI-4 Schema (db/postgres/02-interest.sql)
    - FI-5 Policy switch names (architecture.md, section Policy switches (interest.policy.*))
  - Excluded work:
    - changes to domain or policy classes
    - the loader and the exporter
    - error-path behaviour beyond what restart needs (ticket 08)
- **Dependencies:**
  - ticket 02 (schema) merged
  - ticket 04 (calculation-rules) merged
- **Acceptance:**
  - Input: tables holding the i05-multi-category input. Result: interest_transaction rows for the run in seq_no order equal the expected SYSTRAN records field by field; account equals the expected ACCTDATA.
  - Read order: ORDER BY trancat_acct_id, trancat_type_cd COLLATE "C", trancat_cd; the last account of the input is recognised without a second query per item.
  - Transaction: the inserts of one account's transactions and the update of that account commit together; a forced failure between them leaves neither.
  - Restart: a run forced to fail after the first committed chunk and then restarted ends with the same rows as an uninterrupted run - same transaction ids, no account updated twice.
  - SYSOUT: the run log equals fixtures/interest/&lt;case&gt;/expected/sysout/INTCALC.STEP15.txt; after a restart no line is missing or written twice.
  - Errors: a failure ends the step FAILED with the account id in the message; committed chunks stay committed.
  - Database assertions: no UPDATE touches a column of account other than acct_curr_bal, acct_curr_cyc_credit, acct_curr_cyc_debit; tran_cat_balance, card_xref and disclosure_group are unchanged (row hash before and after).
- **Verification:**
  - Build: mvn -q -f java/interest/pom.xml verify with the db service
  - Tests: integration tests for commit, rollback and restart
  - Fixture cases: i01-baseline, i05-multi-category, i07-nontie-rounding through the tables
  - Final-revision evidence: test summary including the restart test
